items.title: 2.3 Graph of the Square Root Function (Roman Urdu)

blocks.text: Is sabaq mein hum square root function ka graph banana seekhenge. Kitab yahan seedha ek misaal se shuru karti hai, is liye pehle hum buniyadi function \(y = \sqrt{x}\) ko samajh lete hain, phir kitab ki misaal mein usi ko thora badal kar dekhenge.

blocks.title: Teaching note
blocks.text:
Buniyadi square root function \(y = \sqrt{x}\) hai. Yeh sirf \(x \ge 0\) ke liye defined hai (negative number ka square root real nahin hota), aur \(\sqrt{x}\) khud kabhi negative nahin hota. Is ka graph origin se shuru ho kar upar jata hai, magar aahista aahista: \(\sqrt{0} = 0\), \(\sqrt{1} = 1\), \(\sqrt{4} = 2\), \(\sqrt{9} = 3\). Dekhiye, \(x\) ko 1 se 4 tak (teen qadam) le jaane par \(y\) sirf ek barha.
Ab \(y = 2\sqrt{x} + 1\) mein do tabdeeliyan hain: \(2\) har value ko dugna karta hai (graph ko upar ki taraf khenchta hai, vertical stretch), aur \(+1\) poore graph ko ek unit upar sarka deta hai. Is liye graph \((0, 0)\) ki jagah \((0, 1)\) se shuru hota hai.
Rozmarra ki misaal: socha jaye to yeh graph aisa hai jaise naye kaam mein shuru mein tezi se maharat barhti hai, phir aahista aahista; barhti hamesha hai magar raftaar kam hoti jati hai. Square root ka curve bilkul isi tarah ka hai.

blocks.title: Example 10
steps:
Given: square root function \(y = 2\sqrt{x} + 1\).
To find: is ka domain, range, table of values aur graph.
Method: sab se pehle dekhenge ke kaun si \(x\) values allowed hain (domain), phir kaun si \(y\) values nikal sakti hain (range). Phir table banayenge, points plot karenge aur unhein ek hamwaar curve se jorenge.

Step 1: Domain
\(y = 2\sqrt{x} + 1\) ka domain \(x \ge 0\) hai, kyun ke negative number ka square root real number nahin hota.
Kyun: \(\sqrt{-4}\) jaisa number real numbers mein hai hi nahin (woh complex number \(2i\) hai, jo Unit 1 mein parha). Graph sirf real numbers ka banta hai, is liye sirf \(x \ge 0\) allowed hai.

Step 2: Range
\(\sqrt{x}\) kabhi negative nahin hota, yani \(\sqrt{x} \ge 0\). Is liye
\[2\sqrt{x} \ge 0\]
\[2\sqrt{x} + 1 \ge 1\]
aur \(x = 0\) par \(y = 1\) bilkul aa jata hai. Is liye range \(y \ge 1\) hai, yani \([1, \infty)\).
Kyun: kitab ki daleel (square root negative nahin hota) bilkul theek hai, lekin \(+1\) har value ko ek upar utha deta hai. Is liye sab se chhoti \(y\) value \(1\) hai, \(0\) nahin. Kitab yahan ghalti se range "\(y\) bara ya barabar zero" likh deti hai; neeche "Kitab ki ghalti" dekhiye.

Step 3: Table of values
\[x = 0:\ y = 2\sqrt{0} + 1 = 1\]
\[x = 1:\ y = 2(1) + 1 = 3\]
\[x = 2:\ y = 2(1.414) + 1 \approx 3.8\]
\[x = 4:\ y = 2(2) + 1 = 5\]
\[x = 9:\ y = 2(3) + 1 = 7\]
Baaqi values (neeche table mein) isi tarah calculator se nikaal kar ek decimal tak round ki gayi hain.
Kyun: \(0, 1, 4, 9\) perfect squares hain, in ke roots poore numbers hain, is liye in se pakke (exact) points milte hain. Baaqi ke liye calculator chahiye. Hamesha pehle \(\sqrt{x}\) nikaalein, phir 2 se multiply karein, phir 1 jama karein; tarteeb na badlein.

Step 4: Plot kar ke jorein
Table ke points lagayein aur unhein \((0, 1)\) se shuru hone wale hamwaar curve se jorein (neeche table aur graph dekhiye).
Kyun: graph \((0, 1)\) se shuru hota hai kyun ke \(x < 0\) allowed hi nahin. Curve upar jata rehta hai, magar har qadam par uthaan kam hota jata hai: \(x\) ko 0 se 1 karne par \(y\) 2 barha, lekin 9 se 10 karne par sirf 0.3.

Tasdeeq:
Graph ka sab se neeche wala point \((0, 1)\) hai, is liye koi \(y\) value 1 se kam nahin aati: range \(y \ge 1\). Misal ke taur par \(y = 0\) ke liye \(2\sqrt{x} = -1\) chahiye hoga, jo na-mumkin hai kyun ke square root negative nahin ho sakta.
blocks.answer: Domain: \(x \ge 0\); range: \(y \ge 1\). Graph table ke points se guzarta hua curve hai jo \((0, 1)\) se shuru hota hai.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab likhti hai ke \(y = 2\sqrt{x} + 1\) ki range \(y \ge 0\) hai. Yeh ghalat hai. \(2\sqrt{x} \ge 0\) hai, is liye \(2\sqrt{x} + 1 \ge 1\); sahi range \(y \ge 1\) yani \([1, \infty)\) hai. Kitab ka apna table aur graph bhi \(y = 1\) se hi shuru hote hain, jo is ki tasdeeq karta hai.
Function ki table values aur graph neeche diye gaye hain:

blocks.caption: Table (kitab wala): y = 2√x + 1 ki values, ek decimal tak

blocks.alt: Graph of y = 2 times the square root of x, plus 1, for x from 0 to 11, with the y-axis marked 1 to 7. The curve starts at (0, 1) and rises ever more slowly through the table points (1, 3), (4, 5) and (9, 7) up to about (10, 7.3).

blocks.title: Hamari taraf se misaal
blocks.text:
Yeh hamari practice hai (kitab ka sawal nahin): \(y = \sqrt{x} - 2\).
Domain: \(x \ge 0\). Range: \(\sqrt{x} \ge 0 \Rightarrow \sqrt{x} - 2 \ge -2\), yani \(y \ge -2\).
Points: \((0, -2), (1, -1), (4, 0), (9, 1)\). Graph \((0, -2)\) se shuru hota hai aur \(x = 4\) par \(x\)-axis ko kaat'ta hai.
Dekha? Jo number bahar jama ya tafreeq hota hai, wohi range ki shuruaat batata hai.

blocks.title: Khud sochiye
blocks.text: \(y = \sqrt{x - 3}\) ka domain kya hoga? (Jawab: root ke andar wala hissa negative nahin hona chahiye, \(x - 3 \ge 0\), yani \(x \ge 3\). Is ka graph \((3, 0)\) se shuru hoga.) Farq pehchaniye: bahar wala number graph ko upar neeche sarkata hai, andar wala daayen baayen.

blocks.title: Yaad rakhne wali baatein
blocks.text:
1. \(y = \sqrt{x}\): domain \(x \ge 0\), range \(y \ge 0\).
2. \(y = a\sqrt{x} + c\) (\(a > 0\)): domain \(x \ge 0\), range \(y \ge c\); graph \((0, c)\) se shuru.
3. Pakke points ke liye perfect squares (0, 1, 4, 9, ...) lein; baaqi round karein.
4. Curve hamwaar hai aur \(x\) barhne ke saath aahista aahista uthta hai.

blocks.title: Aam ghaltiyan
blocks.text:
1. \(\sqrt{x}\) wali range bina shift ke likh dena: \(2\sqrt{x} + 1\) ki range \(y \ge 1\) hai, \(y \ge 0\) nahin (kitab bhi yahi ghalti kar gayi hai).
2. Negative \(x\) ke points plot karna: woh domain mein hain hi nahin.
3. Points ko seedhe tukron (straight segments) se jorna, ya curve ko \(y\)-axis ke baayen taraf kheench dena.
4. Hisaab ki tarteeb badal dena: pehle \(\sqrt{x}\), phir \(\times 2\), phir \(+1\).
